name: vPhone CLI
tagline: Boot virtual iPhones from the command line via Apple's Virtualization framework
description: vphone-cli is a command-line tool that boots virtual iPhones on Apple silicon Macs using Apple's Virtualization.framework and PCC research VMs. A single command creates a VM, downloads the firmware, patches it, restores it over DFU, installs the custom firmware, and boots it for the first time. It ships five variants — Less, Regular, Developer, Jailbreak, and Experimental — and exposes SSH, VNC, and an MCP control socket for automation. It is the companion CLI to the vphone-ws macOS app and a serious piece of iOS research infrastructure.
highlights: Boots virtual iPhones on Apple silicon with Virtualization.framework and PCC research VMs
One command handles create, download, patch, DFU restore, CFW install, and first boot
Five variants including Jailbreak and Experimental
SSH, VNC, and an MCP control socket for automation
Companion CLI to vphone-ws, from the same author
curatorNote: Virtualized iPhones used to be the stuff of research labs; vphone-cli turns it into a single shell command. With SSH, VNC, and an MCP socket it is a genuinely useful foundation for iOS automation and security work.
